Warrior.d: Your next skill (not ultimates) hits twice.

Tank.d: Your next attack adds your full DEF to its damage, and you gain +25% DEF for 3 turns.

Mage.d: Your next attack deals +30% damage, can't miss, and always applies its element's status (fire burns, ice roots, thunder shocks, light weakens, dark poisons).

Healer.d: For 2 turns: healing +30%, and every heal reaches your whole party at once.

Ranger.d: This turn: +3 range, and your next skill (not ultimates) hits up to 3 enemies in range with +30% damage.

Assassin.d: For 3 turns: cloaked (enemies can't target you, and attacking doesn't break it), +3 move and +50% crit chance.

Gunslinger.d: This turn, fire two different skills, one from each gun, at the same target or two different targets.

Dragon Knight.d: For 3 turns: +7 move, attacks add 25% of their damage as fire, and 35% chance to burn (damage each turn for 3 turns).

Witch.d: For 2 turns: every hit makes the target Immobile for 2 turns and applies Ivy (−30% ATK and DEF for 2 turns), stacking with other debuffs.
